description: Liberty Kenya Holdings Ltd, formerly CFC Insurance Holdings Ltd, is a Kenya-based holding company offering life and property/casualty insurance coverage. Its subsidiaries include CfC Life Assurance Ltd and The Heritage Insurance Company Ltd in Kenya. Liberty Holdings is the strategic investor in CfC Insurance Holdings Ltd.
